schema: gen_radio_sheet.py netlist v1 (+ checker-only keys: croco_edits, external_sources, interface_nets, notes)

croco_edits.why: insert CH334P between the USBLC6 and the RP2350: R9 (27R) now hangs off hub downstream port 1

Coin-cell holder removed (Hazy 2026-10-14 09:07): its 14 x 20 mm area is the only place the WiFi module fits (LOGBOOK 09:02). The cell only powered the RTC (U5 VBAT); the clock is set over WiFi at boot instead. Kept in the schematic as DNP so it can be restored.
MCP79510 VBAT without a backup supply must be tied to VSS (Microchip DS20002300D p9 and section 5.x)
Debug-UART header removed: DEBUG_UART_TX (RP2350 GPIO46) becomes the ESP chip select, the header would leave a stub on CS (netlist note); also frees ~8 x 8 mm at the top edge
Series resistor to the removed J3, same reason

external_sources.VRES: regulator output (Q101 drain 2, a passive pass element, so the checker cannot see a driver); PWR_FLAG on the radio sheet

interface_nets.VLIM: TPS2553 output -> input of the precision input-voltage regulator (Q101 drain 1)
interface_nets.VRES: regulator output (Q101 drain 2) -> reservoir, comparator, TPS63802

notes: Refs U101-U108, R101-R125, C101-C122, L101, Y101 do not clash with Croco (U1-U7, R1-R17, C1-C28, L1, Y1-Y2).
Precision input-voltage regulator VLIM -> VRES added 2026-10-14 (U109, Q101-Q102, R126-R132, C123-C124, D101-D104), values from sim/power/inreg.py DESIGN, audit A8 all pass.
DEBUG_UART_TX (RP2350 GPIO46) becomes the ESP chip select; Croco's R11 + J3 debug header are DNP / off board (croco_edits).

parts.why: Power mux, priority mode: MODE tied to VIN1=VBUS, PR1 divider from VBUS; VIN2 = raw cart VCC (SLVSFG1A 7.3.1 p10, 7.6.1 p12)
PR1 divider top: USB is used when VBUS > 3.55 V nom (3.22-3.89 V worst)
PR1 divider bottom; 7.1 kOhm total also pulls a floating VBUS (D3 reverse leakage) to ground
TPS2116 VIN1 input cap, 1 uF per SLVSFG1A section 9 p16
TPS2116 VIN2 input cap on the cart rail, 1 uF per SLVSFG1A section 9 p16
TPS2116 output (>=0.1 uF for linear soft start, 7.3.2 p11) and TPS2553 IN cap (>=0.1 uF, SLVS841F 7.3 p6)
Pull-up for TPS2116 open-drain ST (high = running from USB), to the radio rail so it cannot back-power the ESP
150 mA constant-current limiter (not the -1 latch-off part); EN is active high on TPS2553 and tied to IN (SLVS841F p5)
Pull-up for open-drain FAULT, read by ESP GPIO4 (= limiter in current limit > 7.5 ms)
Local cap on the limiter output / input of the VLIM->VRES regulator (Hazy designs that stage)

Reservoir, KEMET T520B polymer tantalum, B case 3.5 x 2.8 x 2.1 mm max, 3x = 990 uF, 13.3 mOhm. Replaces the 7.3 x 4.3 mm 6TPE330MAP to free ~85 mm2 (LOGBOOK 09:19); system audit A1-A7 and regulator audit A8 re-run at -20 % C (0.792 mF) with 13.3 mOhm

Ceramic HF bypass at the reservoir bank
TPS63802 input cap, 10 uF recommended (SLVSEU9D 10.2.2.4 p19), at VIN/GND pins
Power-good for the radio: EN on at VRES >= 4.21 V, off below 2.01 V; push-pull out = VRES gives ratiometric hysteresis; POR holds out low below 1.65 V (SBOS300C 9.4.5 p22)
Comparator divider top (see DESIGN_CALCS 3)
Comparator divider bottom
Hysteresis feedback from push-pull output
REF decoupling, <= 10 nF so the reference settles inside the 1.9 ms POR window (SBOS300C 9.4.5 p22)
TLV3012B supply decoupling
Buck-boost VRES (2.0-5.5 V) -> 3.3 V radio rail; MODE=GND = automatic PFM/PWM (SLVSEU9D 9.3.3 p11)
0.47 uH as recommended (SLVSEU9D 8.3 p5, Table 10-2 p19 lists exactly DFE201612E 0.47 uH 5.5 A)
FB top, 511k/91k -> 3.308 V (SLVSEU9D eq.3 p19, Table 10-5 p20)
FB bottom (<=100k required, 10.2.2.5 p19)
TPS63802 output cap, 1x 22 uF for VOUT <= 3.6 V (10.2.2.3 p19)
PG pull-up (open drain, sinks <= 1 mA, 9.3.10 p12)
ESP CHIP_EN RC: PG acts as 3.0-3.14 V supervisor, R per Espressif HW guide 1.3.3
ESP CHIP_EN RC cap; tau 2 ms release / 1 ms reset (see DESIGN_CALCS 7 for why not 1 uF)

Radio. SPI slave on IO_MUX pins (CS=IO10 FSPICS0, SCK=IO6 FSPICLK, MOSI=IO7 FSPID, MISO=IO2 FSPIQ), ADC1 on IO0/IO1, native USB IO18/IO19 | USB_PWR_ST moved from IO3 (pin 6, bottom edge) to IO5 (pin 19, right edge, free, ADC2_CH0/MTDI, plain input here): pin 6 sits over the buck-boost block and could not be routed out (LOGBOOK 15:2x)
ESP 3V3 bulk, 10 uF recommended for TX current steps (HW guide 1.3.2)
ESP 3V3 HF decoupling at module pin 3
Strap GPIO2 = 1 (recommended pull-up, MINI-1 DS Table 4-3 p13)
Strap GPIO8 = 1 (needed for download boot, defined ROM-log level)
Strap GPIO9 = 1 = SPI boot (HW guide 1.3.9: pull-up recommended, no large cap)
VRES sense divider top, k = 0.2273, ATTEN=2 full scale 5.72 V
VRES sense divider bottom
ADC hold cap, tau 0.34 ms (fast enough for the 1 ms firmware loop)
Cart VCC sense divider top (raw VCC before Croco D2); only a 5.7 uA load, cannot source current into VCC
Cart VCC sense divider bottom; also keeps an unpowered VCC net at 0 V
ADC hold cap, tau 0.34 ms
MISO tri-state buffer, /OE = ESP chip select (GPIO46). Powered from Croco +3V3: off with Croco -> Ioff Hi-Z, never drives an unpowered RP2350/SD/RTC (SCES223U 7.3.2 p10)
U105 VCC decoupling

Inbound SCK/MOSI/CS buffer powered from the radio rail: Ioff blocks the RP2350 from back-powering an unpowered ESP through its IO clamps (ESP VIH max = VDD+0.3 V) (SCES366L p1, p8) | DCT (SM8, 0.65 mm pitch) instead of DCU (VSSOP 0.5 mm): the DCU land pattern leaves 0.15 mm between pads, under the board 0.2 mm clearance; same pinout table for both packages (SCES113 Pin Functions), C139356 1427 in stock
U106 VCC decoupling
SCK series damping at the buffer output (HW guide 1.3.8 recommends R on SPI_CLK)

USB 2.0 hub behind Croco USB-C/USBLC6: port 1 -> RP2350 (via existing R9/R10), port 2 -> ESP32-C3. V5 = VDD33 = Croco +3V3 (external 3.3 V mode, CH334 DS 4.2 p19). RESET# and PGANG left open (internal pull-ups, 3.2.2 p11)
Hub crystal (crystal-less mode is a factory option not guaranteed on stock parts, CH334 DS 6.2 p27). No load caps: XI/XO have ~16 pF internal (6.1 p26). Same part as Croco Y1.
CH334P V5 pin cap (>=1 uF, Table 1-3 p4)
CH334P VDD33 decoupling (1 uF option, Table 1-3 p4)
CH334P VDD33 HF decoupling
ESP USB D+ series R, 22-33 R recommended near the chip (HW guide 1.3.12)
ESP USB D- series R

Input-voltage regulator error amp: holds VMUX at 1.24 V x 3.7 = 4.588 V +-1 %; sinks current through REG_K to turn the PMOS pair on while VMUX is above the set-point (sim/power/inreg.py DESIGN, audit A8 (LOGBOOK 08:40))
Back-to-back PMOS pair VLIM -> VRES, sources and gates joined: blocks the reservoir from back-feeding the cart rail in both directions; pass element of the regulator
Set-point divider top (4.588 V); 0.1 % so the set-point stays within +-1 % with the TLV431B
Set-point divider bottom
Gate pull-up to source (PMOS off by default); with R129 = R128 the TLV431 cathode stays >= Vref + 1.2 V (A8.6)
Gate drive from the TLV431 cathode, bounds the TLV431 current to ~4 mA when it saturates
Integrator capacitor, Type-II compensation cathode -> REF (on the gate it caused a 250-320 kHz oscillation, LOGBOOK 08:27); small for fast wind-up recovery
Compensation zero / proportional term; PM >= 58.8 deg, GM >= 16.5 dB over all A8 corners

Gate clamp 1/3: limits Vsg to ~1.8 V (enough for 150 mA, limits how far the gate can be driven) | SOD-523 1N4148WT (C27748, 83k in stock) instead of SOD-323 1N4148WS: same 1N4148 die (the sim model is the 1N4148 one), courtyard 3.1 instead of 6.5 mm2 (LOGBOOK 13:51, layout option A)

Power-on hold: pulse from VMUX keeps Q102 on for ~30-70 ms after hot-plug so the loop starts from off (adds 40-50 mV hot-plug margin; not required to pass)
Power-on hold time constant 47 ms

Power-on hold switch: pulls REF low through R132; Vth 1.0-2.5 V, hot-plug result insensitive across it (LOGBOOK 08:40)
Power-on hold pull-down on REF
